statusDetail: Coverage-complete representative audit of seven public/guest paths. Authenticated account, moderation, studio-detail, profile, payment/donation completion, and project-save/share states were not covered because they require credentials, user mutation, or duplicate inspected templates.

page.framework: React-based SPA/hybrid surfaces plus Scratch editor VM/canvas
page.notes: Public content is client-rendered into #app. Homepage/listing/project/editor/join templates were sampled.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The dark-condition screenshot is visually identical to the default; the computed probe reports colorScheme "normal" under a matching dark query.
Reduced-motion carousel recording produced one static frame over 3 seconds and the animation probe reported no running animations.
Lighthouse reports color-contrast failures; the inspected CSS/probe exposed no high-contrast adaptation for the affected content.
The recorded Home to Explore journey shows navigation/loading frames without a continuity transition.

checkOutcomes.evidence: No tooltip/popover/menu whose placement could be meaningfully tested was exposed in the representative guest paths.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Screenshots show persistent labelled navigation, visually dominant primary actions, project title/context, and explicit editor tutorial controls.
The donation banner pushes rather than overlays content, is clearly labelled, and exposes a visible 32x32 dismiss control on desktop and mobile.
The join surface reports one role=dialog but zero native dialog elements across the inspected UI.
Landing, project, ideas, and editor screenshots devote the principal region to creation/discovery content with restrained navigation chrome.
Layout measured 130px horizontal overflow on the project page and 664px on the editor; the editor layout viewport expanded to 1024px.
The CSS capture contains repeated 480/768/942px media tiers and fixed .inner widths; the probe found zero CSS container rules.
Lighthouse target-size fails; the UI probe measured visible controls as small as 32x32 and text links around 14-18px high.
The landing H1 states the purpose and Start Creating/Join are prominent; project exposes start/See inside; editor opens with a Getting Started tutorial.
The guest Create link reached a functional editor with blocks, stage, start/stop controls and tutorial; Join reached a clear multi-step first screen.
Empty Join submission produced three visible Required messages; the invalid-route screen explains the failure and offers search recovery.
Lighthouse measured LCP 10.9s, CLS 0.781, and TBT 290ms; the independent mobile layout observer measured CLS 0.834.
Direct visual, DOM, Lighthouse, network, interaction, or responsive inspection across the representative paths found the expected outcome with no contrary signal.
The 360px editor layout capture recorded 723ms and 153ms long tasks after load; the project page recorded a 711ms task.
HAR recorded 43 requests and 4.24MB transferred, including 1.29MB splash.intl.js and an 830KB thumbnail; parser-inserted styles/scripts begin at high priority.
HAR shows 1.97MB script transfer; Lighthouse flags large scripts without source maps and the locale bundle alone is 1.29MB.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The image audit found 17 of 18 images without alt; Lighthouse found unnamed links; editor canvases have no role, accessible name, or fallback content.
Lighthouse accessibility audit reports color-contrast failures on the landing surface.
Lighthouse reports aria-hidden slides containing focusable links, skipped heading order, and malformed definition-list structure.
Visual review across desktop/mobile found readable line lengths, clear hierarchy, and no clipped body copy on the landing, ideas, and Join templates.
The editor has 664px overflow at a 360px visual viewport, project has 130px, and Lighthouse target-size fails.
Lighthouse captured 404 console/network errors for /fonts/slick.woff and /fonts/slick.ttf.
All 18 audited images lack width/height attributes; Lighthouse reports incorrectly displayed gallery aspect ratios.
Lighthouse reports deprecated Shared Storage usage in polyfill.min.js and missing maps for large first-party bundles.
Home, Explore, and project probes returned route-specific descriptive titles and meta descriptions.
Discoverability measured only 3% raw-content coverage on home and 1% on the project, both empty #app shells; crawler screenshots are blank.
The platform probe found no canonical URL, while sitemap.xml exists and the public pages return 200.
The metadata probe found Open Graph tags but zero JSON-LD blocks; public project content is a rich CreativeWork-like entity.
Headers show no CSP or nosniff; all three cookies lack Secure and two analytics cookies use SameSite=None for 400 days.
Tracker evidence records Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics; HAR attributes about 300KB to tag-manager scripts and cookies persist 400 days.
The inspected Join flow asks for password and confirmation with autocomplete disabled; inspected app signals exposed no WebAuthn/passkey path.
Headers include HSTS and SAMEORIGIN, but omit CSP/frame-ancestors policy, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, and nosniff.
Raw HTML has an empty #app and only 1-3% of rendered words; crawler screenshots show a blank shell.
Project/player, editor tutorial, listing, and Join dialog rendered without cut-off overlays at desktop; repeated tutorial close/open remained operable.
The platform probe found no manifest and no controlling service worker on the landing surface.
A deliberately invalid route returned a clear illustrated error, explanation, and search field rather than a blank shell.
HTML uses lang=en-GB, but captured CSS repeatedly uses left/right, float:left/right, margin-left/right and fixed directional placement, with no dir declaration.

checkOutcomes.evidence: After 10 tutorial close/open cycles, heap self-size rose from 97,187,667 to 98,592,843 bytes (1.45%); this bounded warm-up-sized delta does not establish unbounded retention.
The complex visual editor used about 89MB JS heap, 2,067 live DOM elements, and a 97.2MB heap snapshot; substantial but proportionate to blocks, canvas, tutorial, media, and VM UI.
Before/after heap summaries contained no Detached* constructor among retained top constructors; repeated interaction caused only a small bounded total delta.

principleOutcomes.reason: This emerging capability is contextual; Scratch exposes no declared agent-facing surface, so absence is an opportunity rather than a failure. No summarisation/language-model feature is part of the representative core journey, so on-device inference is not applicable.

paths.description: Public landing and discovery surface; tested desktop, 360px mobile, dark/reduced-motion preferences, keyboard focus, load performance, privacy, crawler rendering, and primary create navigation.
Representative project-listing template selected from primary navigation.
Representative public project-detail and interactive player template, selected from the featured list.
Primary creation journey and highest-risk long-lived app surface; tutorial opened and its close/open interaction repeated for memory evidence.
Representative learning/content landing template selected from primary navigation.
Representative account creation flow; inspected first step and submitted it empty to observe validation and recovery.
Deliberately invalid URL used to inspect HTTP/error recovery.

findings.summary: The interface does not honor the system dark-color preference.
findings.evidence: The dark-condition screenshot is visually identical to the default; the computed probe reports colorScheme "normal" under a matching dark query.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide tested dark surface/text tokens with prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: Some text fails minimum contrast and there is no contrast-specific adaptation.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports color-contrast failures; the inspected CSS/probe exposed no high-contrast adaptation for the affected content.
findings.suggestedFix: Correct failing color pairs and test forced-colors/prefers-contrast with visible system-color fallbacks.

findings.summary: Primary route changes are abrupt full-document swaps.
findings.evidence: The recorded Home to Explore journey shows navigation/loading frames without a continuity transition.
findings.suggestedFix: Use same-origin cross-document View Transitions with reduced-motion-safe fallback for primary navigation.

findings.summary: Carousels use legacy scripted transforms rather than native snapping/gesture semantics.
findings.evidence: The DOM/CSS capture contains Slick transform-driven carousel rules and custom arrow controls, with no scroll-snap evidence.
findings.suggestedFix: Progressively replace scripted carousel movement with overflow scrolling, scroll-snap, and semantic controls.

findings.summary: Site chrome remains static rather than communicating scroll position.
findings.evidence: Screenshots and captured CSS show fixed/static navigation and scripted carousels but no scroll-state query, progress indicator, or responsive header state.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a lightweight scroll-state-aware header or progress affordance where long listing/detail pages benefit.

findings.summary: Account onboarding uses a custom dialog layer instead of the native dialog primitive.
findings.evidence: The join surface reports one role=dialog but zero native dialog elements across the inspected UI.
findings.suggestedFix: Use <dialog> for the modal flow, preserving focus trapping, Escape close, and return focus through the platform.

findings.summary: Primary project/editor surfaces force desktop widths on a 360px device.
findings.evidence: Layout measured 130px horizontal overflow on the project page and 664px on the editor; the editor layout viewport expanded to 1024px.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide a deliberate compact editor/player layout, avoid minimum desktop widths, and verify every archetype at 360px.

findings.summary: Reusable components rely on viewport breakpoints and fixed-width tiers.
findings.evidence: The CSS capture contains repeated 480/768/942px media tiers and fixed .inner widths; the probe found zero CSS container rules.
findings.suggestedFix: Introduce container-type on reusable panels/cards and adapt internals with @container rather than page-wide width tiers.

findings.summary: Multiple controls and links are too small or too tightly spaced for touch.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse target-size fails; the UI probe measured visible controls as small as 32x32 and text links around 14-18px high.
findings.suggestedFix: Raise interactive hit areas to at least 44x44 CSS px with adequate spacing while retaining visible :focus-visible styles.

findings.summary: The landing page is slow and highly unstable under lab load.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 10.9s, CLS 0.781, and TBT 290ms; the independent mobile layout observer measured CLS 0.834.
findings.suggestedFix: Profile the LCP/shift chain, reserve banner/content space, prioritize the LCP resource, and defer non-critical work.

findings.summary: The interactive editor blocks the main thread with long tasks.
findings.evidence: The 360px editor layout capture recorded 723ms and 153ms long tasks after load; the project page recorded a 711ms task.
findings.suggestedFix: Split startup and editor initialization work, yield with scheduler APIs, and move suitable processing off-thread.

findings.summary: The landing page ships a heavy, poorly prioritized resource set.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 43 requests and 4.24MB transferred, including 1.29MB splash.intl.js and an 830KB thumbnail; parser-inserted styles/scripts begin at high priority.
findings.suggestedFix: Split locale/code payloads, defer non-critical scripts, responsive-load thumbnails, and confirm critical resource ordering.

findings.summary: Large first-party and analytics scripts dominate startup.
findings.evidence: HAR shows 1.97MB script transfer; Lighthouse flags large scripts without source maps and the locale bundle alone is 1.29MB.
findings.suggestedFix: Measure code coverage, split per-route/per-locale bundles, remove legacy/polyfill code for modern clients, and defer analytics.

findings.summary: Key visual and interactive content lacks robust accessible equivalents.
findings.evidence: The image audit found 17 of 18 images without alt; Lighthouse found unnamed links; editor canvases have no role, accessible name, or fallback content.
findings.suggestedFix: Give meaningful image links accessible names, keep decorative alt empty deliberately, and expose canvas/editor state and actions semantically.

findings.summary: Hidden carousel slides remain focusable and document structure is invalid.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports aria-hidden slides containing focusable links, skipped heading order, and malformed definition-list structure.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove descendants of hidden slides from the tab order/inert them, and repair heading and list semantics.

findings.summary: Some foreground/background combinations fail WCAG contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse accessibility audit reports color-contrast failures on the landing surface.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust the failing design tokens to meet 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text/UI.

findings.summary: Reflow and touch-target support is incomplete.
findings.evidence: The editor has 664px overflow at a 360px visual viewport, project has 130px, and Lighthouse target-size fails.
findings.suggestedFix: Build reflow states rather than a scaled desktop canvas and enlarge/space touch targets.

findings.summary: The landing page logs failed font requests.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse captured 404 console/network errors for /fonts/slick.woff and /fonts/slick.ttf.
findings.suggestedFix: Correct or remove the stale Slick font-face URLs and keep production console/network error-free.

findings.summary: Image dimensions, aspect ratios, and delivery are unsound.
findings.evidence: All 18 audited images lack width/height attributes; Lighthouse reports incorrectly displayed gallery aspect ratios.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit intrinsic dimensions/aspect-ratio, use object-fit intentionally, and provide responsive sources.

findings.summary: Deprecated APIs and missing production source maps reduce platform hygiene.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports deprecated Shared Storage usage in polyfill.min.js and missing maps for large first-party bundles.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the deprecated path and publish matching production source maps where policy permits.

findings.summary: Public content is effectively empty to crawlers that do not execute JavaScript.
findings.evidence: Discoverability measured only 3% raw-content coverage on home and 1% on the project, both empty #app shells; crawler screenshots are blank.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render or statically emit meaningful headings, project metadata/content, and crawlable links before hydration.

findings.summary: Canonical indexing signals are incomplete.
findings.evidence: The platform probe found no canonical URL, while sitemap.xml exists and the public pages return 200.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit self-referencing canonical URLs and keep route-level canonical/robots/sitemap signals consistent.

findings.summary: Rich project entities are not expressed as structured data.
findings.evidence: The metadata probe found Open Graph tags but zero JSON-LD blocks; public project content is a rich CreativeWork-like entity.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate schema.org JSON-LD for public projects/organization while retaining route-specific Open Graph metadata.

findings.summary: Transport is HTTPS, but core response and cookie defenses are missing.
findings.evidence: Headers show no CSP or nosniff; all three cookies lack Secure and two analytics cookies use SameSite=None for 400 days.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a tested CSP and nosniff, and set Secure plus the narrowest viable SameSite/retention policy on every cookie.

findings.summary: A child-focused site loads Google tracking on first visit.
findings.evidence: Tracker evidence records Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics; HAR attributes about 300KB to tag-manager scripts and cookies persist 400 days.
findings.suggestedFix: Minimize first-load analytics, shorten retention, avoid identifiers until justified consent/context, and batch only essential measurements.

findings.summary: Account flows present password-only UI with no visible phishing-resistant option.
findings.evidence: The inspected Join flow asks for password and confirmation with autocomplete disabled; inspected app signals exposed no WebAuthn/passkey path.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkeys/WebAuthn for sign-in and use correct autocomplete tokens as a fallback password path.

findings.summary: Several browser-enforced defensive policies are absent.
findings.evidence: Headers include HSTS and SAMEORIGIN, but omit CSP/frame-ancestors policy, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, and nosniff.
findings.suggestedFix: Add restrictive Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy and mature CSP toward frame-ancestors/Trusted Types where compatible.

findings.summary: Core public content depends entirely on JavaScript.
findings.evidence: Raw HTML has an empty #app and only 1-3% of rendered words; crawler screenshots show a blank shell.
findings.suggestedFix: Ship meaningful public content and links in server HTML, then hydrate enhancements.

findings.summary: The app-like creation experience is neither installable nor offline-capable.
findings.evidence: The platform probe found no manifest and no controlling service worker on the landing surface.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a web app manifest and a conservative service worker with an offline shell/fallback for editor startup and saved local work.

findings.summary: Language is declared, but layout CSS is heavily physical and not bidi-ready.
findings.evidence: HTML uses lang=en-GB, but captured CSS repeatedly uses left/right, float:left/right, margin-left/right and fixed directional placement, with no dir declaration.
findings.suggestedFix: Adopt logical properties and test a dir=rtl locale while preserving correct per-locale lang/dir.

findings.summary: Signup explicitly disables helpful autofill.
findings.evidence: The Join probe reports autocomplete="off" for username, password, and password confirmation.
findings.suggestedFix: Use username, new-password, and new-password autocomplete tokens so password managers can assist safely.

findings.summary: Most image bytes are oversized legacy PNGs with no responsive delivery.
findings.evidence: Image audit found 14 oversized images, 15 legacy-format images, 16 without srcset, and 15 below-fold images not lazy-loaded.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate AVIF/WebP variants and responsive srcset/sizes, reserve dimensions, and lazy-load below-fold thumbnails.

findings.summary: Non-essential bytes and tracking work execute during initial load.
findings.evidence: HAR records 4.24MB on load, 21 cross-origin requests, large below-fold thumbnails, and analytics collection before interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer below-fold media and analytics, fetch only visible cards, and prioritize user-visible work.

findings.summary: Third-party and media cost is disproportionate for the landing view.
findings.evidence: 2.54MB of 4.24MB transferred cross-origin; image payload is 2.26MB and tag-manager scripts add about 300KB.
findings.suggestedFix: Set per-template byte/request budgets, serve right-sized thumbnails, and remove or delay low-value third-party code.

taskList.title: Make public content server-rendered and progressively enhanced
Fix LCP/CLS and cut startup payloads
Create compact responsive project and editor layouts
Repair accessible names, carousel focus, structure, contrast, and targets
Harden headers, cookies, and child-focused analytics privacy
Add preference-aware theme and modern interaction affordances
Clean production asset and browser hygiene errors
Make the app installable with a safe offline fallback
Replace physical layout properties and test RTL
